cuts.ofreeRecent: a small shop — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a mossy path under ancient oaks with shafts of light — standing; a Roman marble bath hall — standing; a sunny beach with wet sand and shallow surf — kneeling on the ground; a sunlit white marble temple — holds a small bouquet at chest height; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; the riverside park at the Red Cliffs on the Yangtze — lying on her front; a walkway through a forest dome inside a colony ship — standing; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — perched on a ledge or edge; inside a general's command tent — holds a book closed against her chest; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; a running track with lane lines and a grandstand — standing
